theorem _root_.CompressionEval.smoke_la_02 {α β : Type*} (s : Finset α) (t : Finset β) (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty) :
  (s.product t).Nonempty ∧ 0 < s.card * t.card :=
by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ht
    exact ⟨(a,b), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨ha,hb⟩⟩
  · exact Nat.mul_pos (Finset.card_pos.mpr hs) (Finset.card_pos.mpr ht)
